claim: The learn-a-trade escape hatch is closing: the humanoid robots are showing up, and the day one works inside your house it is one robot for every trade.
why_this_claim: It is the hook's own turn (learn to code failed, learn a trade is failing next) landed on Mike's own angle, the robot-in-your-house argument that CH3 calls the heart of the video. It needs no number, no chart, no receipt and no coin to stand up cold, so it survives without the other 18 minutes, and it is the one claim whose proof sits almost entirely on FACE windows 1 to 10 (the clean background swap) plus two Envato/AI-still covers that re-frame to 9:16. The answer (ownership, crypto) is deliberately withheld: the kicker is the longform's own open loop (there is a way to protect yourself, first you need to see how deep this goes), so the CTA closes on a question instead of giving the payoff away.

assembled_read: First they told you learn to code, but then AI learned to code. So then they told you scratch that, go learn a trade, because a chatbot can't fix a toilet. And the humanoid robots are showing up. There's no robot electrician, but they're coming, and they're coming fast. It's one robot for every trade in your house. There's a way to protect yourself from all this. We're going to get to that, but first you need to see how deep this goes. [CTA] Click below to watch the full video.
